title: When appetite leaves no room for Naam
subtitle: For the hour when pleasure starts occupying the whole heart
description: A short bundle for the crowded interior where gold, comfort, taste, and craving all ask to be obeyed. It clears space for Naam before desire names itself as need.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The shabad lists the body’s many pleasures, then asks how Naam can dwell in a heart already crowded by them.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Interrupt one appetite before it becomes automatic, and make that cleared space a place for remembrance.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle names greed as crowded attention, not merely wanting too much, and returns that attention to Naam.
evidence.turn: For when the next taste, purchase, or comfort is beginning to command the room
evidence.practicalImplication: Use the three linked steps to slow the appetite, examine what it is occupying, and give the heart back to remembrance.
